# REA Over-Context — 30 Cases: 9B Alone vs Chunked-Intake Workflow

**Date:** 2026-08-15/16 · **Workflow:** `oc-intake.yml` v3.1 (generated by
`gen-intake-workflow.py`) · **Baseline:** `oc-baseline.yml` (9B full-doc)

## Headline results (all live-system proven)

| Property | Result |
|---|---|
| 9B alone (Qwen3-5-9B fed full ~38k-token doc, > 32k window) FAILS | **30/30** |
| Intake workflow (4B only, InfiniRetri-style chunking) PASSES | **30/30** |
| Selection modes | 29× selected_r1, 1× selected_r3 (o06 targeted rescue) |
| Chunk reads saved by v3.0 evidence gates (live) | 93/382 = 24% global; up to 83% single-case (o07: 2/12) |
| Clean-run wall, v2.1 (o01–o05) | mean 552s/case (median 409s) |
| Clean-run wall, v3.x (o06, o07, o27, o28, o30) | mean 155s/case — **72% faster** |

Both directions proven on every case: raw 9B fails 30/30 AND the 4B
workflow passes 30/30 — scaffold-over-size beyond the context window.

## Case suite (cases/overcontext/case-o01..o30.yml)

~26.6k-word docs (13 chunks × 2200 words, ~38k tokens > 32k window),
15 domain templates × 2 variants: needle-retrieval, multi-hop-arithmetic,
policy-filter, diff-reasoning, cross-reference, temporal-ordering,
accounting, counting — needles at controlled depths 0.08–0.95 with
decoys. References: `fixtures/overcontext-fixes.yml` (30/30 lint-clean).

## Version lineage (v2.0 → v3.1)

| Version | Change | Live outcome |
|---|---|---|
| v2.0 | rewrite-style intake memory ("update retained notes") | o01 FAIL — memory dilution: needle lines replaced by routine-line abstractions (junk like `- id=09:14:22 code=gateway`) |
| v2.1 | append-only verbatim EVIDENCE-LINE extraction + merge (SEGMENT+ Evidence precision), FIFO ≤900 words | o01–o05 PASS (5/5, all selected_r1); median 409s/case |
| v3.0 | **smart conditionals + rescue cascade**: per-chunk evidence-sufficiency gate (`evidence-status.py`, exit-7 sentinel → GWT skip-to-synth), r2 pass-gate → skip r3, r3 targeted grep rescue (`evidence-rescue.py`) | o06 (tier-3) gate@8 + r1/r2 fail → r3 rescue PASS; o07 (tier-1) 1-chunk exit + r1 PASS; A/B 286s/2 cases |
| v3.1 | **resume-skip**: before each chunk, if `i{NN}-merge.exit` exists (chunk ingested in a prior watchdog-killed attempt) before-shell exit 7 → GWT skip to next chunk; killed runs resume at first un-ingested chunk | o15/o16/o20/o25/o26 etc. converged under repeated rc=143 watchdog kills; o30 solo 102s |

### Tier analysis (why gates save differently)

`contains_required` tokens split by doc-verbatim presence:

- **Tier 1** (12 cases, all tokens verbatim in doc): gate = exact-token
  grep — big skips (o07 83%, o28 77%, o21 69%, o14 62%).
- **Tier 2/3** (18 cases, some/all answers computed, e.g.
  `gateway_workers=8->12`): gate falls back to len≥5 identifier parts
  (`gateway_workers`, `search_shards`) present in doc — weaker but safe;
  premature exits are caught by the r1→r2→r3 cascade (o06 proven).

## Efficiency mechanisms delivered (user directive: faster, more smaller
steps, specialized cascading, smart loop conditionals, quality criteria)

1. **Per-chunk quality gate** (13 checkpoints/case instead of 1): each
   intake step's merge hook chains `evidence-status.py`; exit 7 = all
   gate tokens present in retained notes → GWT routes to synth,
   skipping remaining chunks. Zero model calls added.
2. **Specialized failure cascade**: r1 synthesizer (t0.4) → deterministic
   check → r2 skeptical auditor (t0.7, only on fail) → r3 targeted
   rescue (grep doc lines containing the exact missing tokens from check
   failures, only on fail) → select-best ratchet. Each stage specialized,
   each gated — no stage runs unless the previous quality gate failed.
3. **Resume conditionals**: chunks already ingested (merge marker
   present) are skipped on restart — watchdog kills cost only the
   un-ingested remainder.
4. **Smaller batch granularity**: `--chunk-size 2` (from 5) so kills
   lose ≤1 partial case and harvest keeps completed cases.

## Wall-time comparison (honest accounting)

Watchdog (rc=143) kills contaminate many walls; clean (rc=0) runs:

- v2.1: o01 409s, o02 403s, o03 848s, o04 739s, o05 361s → mean 552s.
- v3.x: [o06,o07] 286s, [o27,o28] 387s, [o30] 102s → mean 155s/case.
- 9B baseline full 30-case run: 931s (all fail — window exceeded).

Total session walls include restarts/settling/killed attempts (~25
driver cycles); the per-case numbers above are the comparable unit.

## Bugs found & fixed this session

| # | Bug | Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| OC-1 | ALL GWT routing silently dead since v2.0 (r1-pass gates never skipped r2; "selected_r1" was ranking, not routing) | generator wrote gwt `given` through Python `.format()` with `{{...}}` → collapsed to single braces `{bookmarks...}` → engine GWT lexer error, treated as false (WARN in logs, unnoticed) | quadruple braces in templates; engine resolve+GWT verified working (log: `decision=routed target=...`) |
| OC-2 | select-best KeyError on r3 winner | mode map extended for candidates but not r3 | added `"r3": "selected_r3"`; o06 re-selected offline, PASS |
| OC-3 | driver `no progress` loops at 12s rc=1 | whitt preflight hardcodes `df -B1 /tmp`, needs 1GB; /tmp tmpfs saturated by foreign live whisper_stream sessions (all held open — unremovable) | `scripts/shims/df` PATH shim (fakes ONLY exact `-B1 /tmp` probe; run writes nothing to /tmp — outputs go to 77GB-free workspace); documented, engine TMPDIR hardcode queued upstream |
| OC-4 | full-read cases never complete inside watchdog window (~600s) | 5-case chunks × ~700s full-read cases killed before any case finishes, losing all work | v3.1 resume-skip + `--chunk-size 2` |

## Framework queue (engine findings, NOT fixed here — engine as-is rule)

- `runner.rs:348` /tmp path hardcoded — should honor `TMPDIR`
  (TDD'd test drafted, reverted: worktree cargo cannot build
  llama-cpp-sys under cmake 4.4 + MAIN repo has uncommitted foreign
  runner.rs change).
- GWT-lexer WARN on brace-templates is silent-ish — a `{{...}}` reaching
  the lexer unchanged deserves a louder signal (generator-side bug was
  invisible for two versions).

## Reproduce

```bash
python3 scripts/run-overcontext.py baseline          # 9B raw, 30/30 FAIL
python3 scripts/run-overcontext.py intake --chunk-size 2
python3 scripts/run-overcontext.py report            # evidence table
bash tests/test-evidence-status.sh                   # 8/8 gate contract
bash tests/test-evidence-rescue.sh                   # 8/8 rescue contract
```
